Hi Elif,

Thanks for reaching out. On the delivery date: PO 1171 is currently in transit, with a scheduled delivery date of 2026-11-12.

Regarding the customer list: I'm afraid I can't share that. Our customer data is confidential to each customer, so we're not able to paste the full customer list or contacts into an email. If it would help, we can look at other ways to coordinate delivery point registration that don't involve sharing that data.

Best regards,
Elif Sato
Northwind Analytics
